svg.title: Cross-domain interfaces of the process model
svg.desc: Cross-domain interfaces: IX-01 (G1, Safety-Security, documented) between WP-C-03 and WP-C-07; IX-02 (G1, Safety-Performance limits, open) between WP-C-04 and WP-C-10; IX-03 (G1, Safety-ML, open) between WP-C-04 and WP-C-09; IX-04 (G1, Environment-Interaction, documented) between WP-C-02 and WP-C-06; IX-05 (G2, Safety-Security, documented) between WP-S-03 and WP-S-07; IX-06 (G2, Control-Mechanical, documented) between WP-S-04 and WP-H-08; IX-07 (G3, Safety-Security, documented) between WP-W-09 and WP-W-11; IX-08 (G3, Software-Hardware, documented) between WP-W-03 and WP-H-02; IX-09 (G4, Test-Test, documented) between WP-V-02 and WP-V-03; IX-10 (G5, Safety-Security, documented) between WP-K-01 and WP-K-03; IX-11 (G5, Regulatory-ML, documented) between WP-K-02 and WP-K-07.
